card.name: Place or source words after named things
card.fires_on: Small linking words (from, on, for, or, in, at, and) that come right after a named place, venue, event or website in general web text. The linking word introduces where something is, happens or can be found.

modes.label: Location links
modes.description: A preposition after a venue or place name that leads into another place or location.
modes.example: The museum occupies the first two floors of an office tower across<< from>> Madison Square Park.

modes.label: Platform or contact links
modes.description: A linking word after a website, social handle or contact method that leads to another option.
modes.example: visit the website: http://milan.tennessee.edu<< or>> call (731) 6

modes.label: Venue or event links
modes.description: A preposition after an exhibit, show or museum name that names where it is held.
modes.example: an ongoing exhibit in the History Museum<< at>> the Castle, lets visitors get a first

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about experiences, places and sharing, and away from online or conversation words.
card.plain: It fires on little words like from, on or at that follow a place or venue name and lead into where something happens.
